events.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import pearsonr
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('inputs')
ann=pd.read_csv(p/'Sample_annotated_Zenodo.csv')
meta=pd.read_csv(p/'GeneMetaInfo_Zenodo.csv', index_col=0)
counts=pd.read_csv(p/'BatchCorrectedReadCounts_Zenodo.csv', index_col=0)
print('shapes ann/meta/counts',ann.shape,meta.shape,counts.shape)
print('ann celltype counts',ann['celltype'].value_counts(dropna=False).to_dict())
print('sample unique',ann['sample'].is_unique,'count columns unique',counts.columns.is_unique)
print('sample sets counts-ann',len(set(counts.columns)-set(ann['sample'])),len(set(ann['sample'])-set(counts.columns)))
print('gene indices unique meta/counts',meta.index.is_unique,counts.index.is_unique)
print('gene set counts-meta',len(set(counts.index)-set(meta.index)),len(set(meta.index)-set(counts.index)))
print('meta geneid match index', (meta.index.astype(str)==meta.Geneid.astype(str)).value_counts().to_dict())
print('biotypes top',meta.gene_biotype.value_counts().head(10).to_dict())
print('missing meta',meta[['Length','gene_biotype']].isna().sum().to_dict())
cd14=ann.loc[ann.celltype.eq('CD14'),'sample'].tolist()
print('CD14 n',len(cd14),'all present',set(cd14)<=set(counts.columns))
x=counts[cd14]
print('selected missing cells',int(x.isna().sum().sum()),'min max',x.min().min(),x.max().max(),'negative',int((x<0).sum().sum()))
pc=meta.index[meta.gene_biotype.eq('protein_coding')]
df=pd.DataFrame({'Length':meta.loc[pc,'Length'], 'mean':x.reindex(pc).mean(axis=1), 'total':x.reindex(pc).sum(axis=1), 'alltotal':counts.reindex(pc).sum(axis=1)})
for label,mask in [('cd14_total_ge10',df.total.ge(10)),('all_total_ge10',df.alltotal.ge(10)),('cd14_any_ge10',(x.reindex(pc)>=10).any(axis=1)),('all_pc',pd.Series(True,index=df.index))]:
    d=df.loc[mask,['Length','mean']].dropna()
    print(label,'n',len(d),'r scipy',repr(pearsonr(d.Length,d['mean']).statistic),'r numpy',repr(np.corrcoef(d.Length,d['mean'])[0,1]),'mean range',d['mean'].min(),d['mean'].max())
print('cd14 total excluded',int((df.total<10).sum()),'equals mean*n maxerr',float((df['total']-df['mean']*len(cd14)).abs().max()))
print('length dtype/range',df.Length.dtype,df.Length.min(),df.Length.max())
PY"

events.command:
/bin/bash -lc "Rscript - <<'RS'
options(digits=17)
ann <- read.csv('inputs/Sample_annotated_Zenodo.csv', check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
meta <- read.csv('inputs/GeneMetaInfo_Zenodo.csv', check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
cts <- read.csv('inputs/BatchCorrectedReadCounts_Zenodo.csv', check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
cat('dimensions ann/meta/cts:', paste(dim(ann),collapse='x'), paste(dim(meta),collapse='x'), paste(dim(cts),collapse='x'),'\\n')
cat('column names meta:',paste(names(meta),collapse='|'),'\\n')
cat('column names counts first/last:',paste(head(names(cts),3),collapse='|'),paste(tail(names(cts),3),collapse='|'),'\\n')
cat('cell types:\\n'); print(table(ann"'$celltype,useNA='"'ifany'))
cat('duplicate sample/meta/count gene IDs:',sum(duplicated(ann"'$sample)),sum(duplicated(meta[[1]])),sum(duplicated(cts[[1]])),'"'\\n')
cat('sample set differences counts-ann / ann-counts:',length(setdiff(names(cts)[-1],ann"'$sample)),length(setdiff(ann$sample,names(cts)[-1])),'"'\\n')
cat('gene set differences counts-meta / meta-counts:',length(setdiff(cts[[1]],meta[[1]])),length(setdiff(meta[[1]],cts[[1]])),'\\n')
cat('meta ID equality:',sum(meta[[1]] == meta"'$Geneid,na.rm=TRUE),'"'of',nrow(meta),'\\n')
cd14 <- ann"'$sample[ann$celltype == '"'CD14']
cat('CD14 n/present:',length(cd14),sum(cd14 %in% names(cts)),'\\n')
idx <- match(meta[[1]],cts[[1]])
pc <- meta"'$gene_biotype == '"'protein_coding'
mat <- as.matrix(cts[idx[pc], cd14, drop=FALSE])
storage.mode(mat) <- 'double'
len <- meta"'$Length[pc]
tot <- rowSums(mat)
mn <- rowMeans(mat)
allmat <- as.matrix(cts[idx[pc], -1, drop=FALSE]); storage.mode(allmat)<-'"'double'
alltot <- rowSums(allmat)
variants <- list(cd14_total_ge10=tot>=10, all_total_ge10=alltot>=10,
                 cd14_any_ge10=apply(mat>=10,1,any), all_pc=rep(TRUE,length(tot)))
cat('protein coding n:',sum(pc),' missing length:',sum(is.na(len)),'missing selected:',sum(is.na(mat)),'negative selected:',sum(mat<0,na.rm=TRUE),' range:',range(mat,na.rm=TRUE),'\\n')
for (nm in names(variants)) {
 keep <- variants[[nm]] & is.finite(len) & is.finite(mn)
 cat(nm,'n',sum(keep),'r',format(cor(len[keep],mn[keep],method='pearson'),digits=17,scientific=FALSE),'mean range',paste(range(mn[keep]),collapse=' '),'\\n')
}
cat('excluded cd14 threshold:',sum(tot<10),' total range:',paste(range(tot),collapse=' '),'length range:',paste(range(len,na.rm=TRUE),collapse=' '),'\\n')
cat('mean-total identity max error:',max(abs(mn*length(cd14)-tot)),'\\n')
RS"

events.command:
/bin/bash -lc "Rscript - <<'RS'
options(digits=17)
a <- read.csv('inputs/Sample_annotated_Zenodo.csv', check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
g <- read.csv('inputs/GeneMetaInfo_Zenodo.csv', check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
c <- read.csv('inputs/BatchCorrectedReadCounts_Zenodo.csv', check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
s <- a"'$sample[a$celltype == '"'CD14']
p <- g"'$gene_biotype == '"'protein_coding'
z <- as.matrix(c[match(g[[1]][p],c[[1]]),s]); storage.mode(z) <- 'double'
x <- as.double(g"'$Length[p]); y <- rowMeans(z); keep <- rowSums(z) >= 10
x <- x[keep]; y <- y[keep]
manual <- sum((x-mean(x))*(y-mean(y))) / sqrt(sum((x-mean(x))''^2)*sum((y-mean(y))''^2))
cat(format(manual,digits=17), '"'\\n')
cat(format(cor(x,y),digits=17), '\\n')
cat('boundary totals:',sum(rowSums(z)==9),sum(rowSums(z)==10),'retained',length(x),'\\n')
RS"
